method: Manual interpretation of separately labelled fine-quarter outlines on the exact original embedded JPEG of the 2021 consultation-draft municipal figure 81. Manually identified source-stroke seeds guide continuous 8-neighbor source-pixel paths. For the literal-source layer every dense vertex has maxRGB <= 45. Only exactly collinear vertices are removed. A metric affine fit in EOV/EPSG:23700 using five literal contemporary OSM-node coordinates and manually placed approximate old-image road junctions georeferences the source pixels; the result is converted to WGS84. No current-road replacement, source-frame closure, arbitrary chord, buffer, geometric snapping or geometry repair is used. This candidate has narrowly bounded dark-blue source-label crossings: the underlying black outline is obscured, and its continuation through actual dark-blue source pixels is manually interpreted. It is an explicit estimate, not a literal-black boundary reconstruction; the exact affected pixels and lengths are archived.
